networks.name: verified_stay
networks.description: Ask about Verified Stay's rooms, prices and policies, choose a room and book it.
sample_queries: Which room fits four guests, and what does it cost per night?
Put the Family Room in the booking box for two nights.
Book the room in the booking box for Sam Rivera.
Who receives the deposit, and where is the payment quote?
Can you arrange an airport taxi for us?

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions only. Partner sites listed in bridge/bridge-actions.js may read rooms and prices and open a booking window on this site, where the visitor types the guest name.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.

trust.note: Declarations for agents that check a site before they pay or book. All addresses are sample values on a test network.
